patch:
diff --git a/kv/cache.py b/kv/cache.py
index e936d4f..7196f3c 100644
--- a/kv/cache.py
+++ b/kv/cache.py
@@ -7,3 +7,6 @@ class Cache:
 
     def put(self, key, value):
         self.items[key] = value
+
+    def invalidate(self, key):
+        self.items.pop(key, None)
diff --git a/kv/service.py b/kv/service.py
index aae2287..e5127ce 100644
--- a/kv/service.py
+++ b/kv/service.py
@@ -16,3 +16,8 @@ class Service:
 
     def update(self, key, value):
         self.store.set(key, value)
+        self.cache.invalidate(key)
+
+    def delete(self, key):
+        self.store.remove(key)
+        self.cache.invalidate(key)
